rulings.raw: 1 pound ground chicken (or chicken breast or thighs in a food processor)
rulings.evidence: No commodity claims it; captures exist today. Ground is a real form flip from chicken-breast or boneless-skinless-chicken-thigh - different price class and different gram basis - and it is not ground-turkey (different bird), so it goes to the registrar as a new id rather than onto any existing chicken row.
REUSE of the live board id `eggs` (7 of 7, 1.00 at Hy-Vee); only the vocabulary row was missing. Whole egg, 50 g shelled.

rulings.raw: 2 tablespoons fresh herbs, like fresh basil or fresh parsley chopped, to serve
rulings.evidence: Optional to-serve garnish that the line itself lets you satisfy with parsley, which this recipe already buys as a settled fresh-parsley line; 'fresh herbs' reads board-ABSENT only as a generic string, so no new id is warranted.

macro_cross_check.verdict: pass - protein within 3%, which confirms the 1 lb ground chicken and the 50 g egg
